skipped.sap.m/iconExplorer: Maintainer decision 2026-09-13: left out. The app is a live search, filter and sort over ~1,800 icons with the favourites in the browser's local storage - the one demo app whose whole point is a smart client, and the clearest example of where abap2UI5 is the wrong shape (see the framework's insight #34).
skipped.sap.m/theming: Needs a custom control and a runtime API that is not view-level: the ColorPreview control is the app's own JavaScript, and the toolbox reads sap/ui/core/theming/Parameters at runtime. Both are frontend code an abap2UI5 app would have to ship alongside the class, which is a deployment step this package does not take.
skipped.sap.tnt/toolpageapp: Needs four custom D3 chart controls (D3PieChart, D3ColumnChart, D3ComparisonChart) plus sap.suite micro charts, which ship with SAPUI5 and not with OpenUI5. The sap.tnt.ToolPage shell itself is expressible - z2ui5_cl_smpc_app ports cover sap.tnt - so what is missing is the charts, not the app frame.
